cards: **W1 · In-silico enumeration of capsid–receptor complexes (AlphaFold-class sampling).** seed pick · compute tested: yes · plan expects: unsure · halted: cost record broken **Question.** Does deep AlphaFold sampling of capsid peptides against receptor ectodomains converge on one transferable binding footprint that separates BBB-crossing from intracellular AAVs [S2]? **What is known.** AFsample generated about 6000 AlphaFold-Multimer models per CASP15 target, raising mean DockQ from 0.41 to 0.55 versus 25 defaults, but never tested capsid–receptor footprint convergence [S3]. Whether many seeds converge on one capsid–receptor interface footprint or keep alternating; the only AAV application found its PHP.C2–LY6C1 pose changed with AlphaFold-Multimer version [S2]. **Hypothesis.** Deep sampling to 480 predictions per pair reveals one dominant footprint per receptor class, since the validated PHP.eB–LY6A pose was stable [S2]. **If compute is the lever.** At 480 predictions per pair, split-half contact Jaccard reaches 0.7 and one footprint holds 80% of poses across weight sets. **If not.** Even at 480 predictions per pair, split-half contact Jaccard stays below 0.4 with two footprints alternating, as PHP.C2–LY6C1 poses changed with AlphaFold version [S2]. **Test.** Sample 36 capsid-peptide × receptor-ectodomain pairs at 30, 150 and 480 AlphaFold-Multimer predictions each; compare footprints against a default 25-prediction run and sequential versus eight-copy pipelines; score contacts against mutagenesis and PDB 7WQO [S2,S8]. *Compute axis.* AlphaFold-Multimer predictions sampled per capsid-peptide x receptor-ectodomain pair (seeds x five models x runs): 30–480 predictions per pair, 3 levels. Closest prior: 6,000 [s3]. *Restructuring.* none. **Check first.** Our PHP.eB capsid model must match cryo-EM PDB 7WQO within 1.4 Å backbone RMSD and put LY6A A58 at the peptide interface [S2]. Tolerance: backbone RMSD <= 1.4 Å (published 0.36 Å overall, 1.36 Å in the engineered loop) and LY6A A58 within 5 Å in >= 80% of top-decile poses. **Would not show.** Predicted footprints cannot show which AAVs transcytose across brain endothelium; cell and animal assays must do that [S2]. Glycan contacts and full-capsid trimer poses are outside this budget. *Cost.* The cost record did not evaluate (7 errors); see the cost block. **Halted at cost record broken.** reserved at numbers.budget_usd: budget_usd is set by the question;
